rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
Huge trees tower above you, blocking out most of the sky's light.
The brush all around you is rustled by things unseen.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
Nothing stirs in this section of the forest, although you can hear 
things - many things - moving farther out all around you.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
Dead leaves crunch under your boots as you weave your way through the
endless trees of the forest.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
You see something scamper though the trees above your head, then vanish.
The nagging thought of something dropping down on you makes you keep your
head up.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
The trees all around you seem to be normal ironwood - hard as steel and
stretching out into the sky.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
A large stump is here, ages old. Looking around, you see other stumps
spread out in the surrounding woods. You wonder who would go to such 
lengths of cutting an ironwood tree - and how.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
Leaves suddenly rain down on you from above. Something is definitely
up there, but you see no easy way to get there.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
Dead leaves whip around you as a sudden breeze springs up. It makes
the coldness of the forest seem more oppressive.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
A tree before you stands out because it is totally bare, almost as if
something had shaken all the leaves off. But what could be that strong?

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc: Wind whispers through the trees, almost sounding like voices.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
Eyeing the treetops above, you see two red eyes glaring out of a dark
canopy.  You wonder how many other living beings inhabit the treetops.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
A tree just ahead of you has been stripped of its bark.  This boggles
your mind since ironwood bark is one of the hardest substances on the
earthly plane.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc: Shadows deepen all around you as move further into the forest.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
Dead branches rain down on you from above, knocked into the air by an 
unseen traveler in the treetops.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
Old legends of this forest scared you as a child, and seeing it now you
know why.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
The smell of rotting leaves beneath your feet coupled with the noises
of the forest make you wonder if you are the only first person to walk
here.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
To the east a section of the forest seems to be swaying madly in the
wind, but here, all is calm.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
A tangle of vines cling to your boots for a moment, tightening as you
move. You hope that the other, larger vegetation in the forest is not as
hungry.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
Your trek through the forest stirs up a nest of brush birds, who startle
you with their loud squawking before flying up into a nearby tree to watch
you pass by.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
An exceptionally large ironwood tree stands here. It is easily ten feet
in diameter and probably thousands of years old.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
Leaves crunch under your boots as you work your way through the maze
of trees.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
Leaves crunch under your boots as you work your way through the maze of
trees.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
Leaves crunch under your boots as you work your way through the maze of
trees.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
Rotting leaves under your feet assault your nostrils, and the forest's 
cool breeze seeps through the chinks in your armor.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc: The forest stretches out around you in all directions.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
A deep fog rolls in about your ankles. The woods, before shrouded in
shadows are now steeped in darkness.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc: All about, the shadows move, unaccounted for even in the slight breeze.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
The tall ironwood trees surrounding you are suddenly still as the breeze
dies.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
Your boots crunch in the dead leaves below you boots, but below the leaves
lies a soggy morass of swamp. You look about warily for sinkholes.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc: Trees, trees, and more trees. All around you are trees.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
Eyeing the trees nervously, you get the definite feeling you're being
watched.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc: All around you the tall ironwood trees stand like silent guardians.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
Leaves and branches shower down upon you from above. Looking up, you
see nothing.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc: A small ring of mushrooms grows here, but nothing else seems out of place.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
A wave of evil washes over you from the east. The trees here seem darker
than elsewhere in the forest.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
Ironwood trees surround you on all sides, but you are able to push through
them with only a little difficulty. The forest is alive with noise all around
you.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc: The trees all around you seem to stretch on endlessly.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
Peering through the trees, you keep catching glimpses of movement out
of the corner of your eye.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
The rotting leave are thinner here, as is the space between the trees
where the sky shows through.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
The tree canopy above you is almost fully blocking the sky now. The
shadows around you deepen.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc: There really are a great many trees around here.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
Darkness reigns supreme in this section of the forest. The tall ironwoods
around you block all light from above and amplify the sounds of the creatures
that you now know surround you.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
The forest is turning into a bog. Water seeps up between the dead leaves
at your feet, and mushrooms grow abundantly.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
Red eyes glow from behind the trees all around you, then wink out all
at once as if by some unheard signal.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc: You are pretty sick of seeing trees. They seem to go on forever.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
The mist around your ankles almost obscures the leaves over which you
walk. You look carefully ahead for sinkholes.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
The forest's mist is thicker here, obscuring your view for all but a
few feet ahead of you.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
The thick rolls all around you, leaving you with your hand in front of
your face to protect you from stray branches.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc: Leaves fall down all around you, disturbed from above by something unseen.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc: Leaves fall down all around you, disturbed from above by something unseen.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc: Leaves fall down all around you, disturbed from above by something unseen.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
All around you, you suddenly hear whispered voices in an unknown language.
There is much more hidden here than what stands before you from time to time.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
Pools of water form around your footsteps, erasing them as soon as you
pass. You begin to wonder if you aren't lost.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a darker section of the forest, smothered by 
shadows and choked by the mists that surround you.  Crumpled leaves
litter the ground, damp from the moisture that seems confined to the
forest floor.
   You can hack through the forest in any direction.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
The mist swirls around you, making the land seem hazy and dreamlike. 
The towering dark trees make it seem more like a nightmare.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
The tall ironwood trees around you suddenly echo as if struck; a harsh
metallic 'clang' reaches your ears, but you can't tell where it comes from.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
A large branch the size of your arm crashes down beside you. You swear
up at the treetop, yet thank fate that you weren't knocked out.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
The tall ironwood trees around you suddenly echo as if struck; a harsh
metallic 'clang' reaches your ears, but you can't tell where it comes from.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc: The forest thickens here, becoming almost impassable.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc: The forest thickens here, becoming almost impassable.

rooms.name: The Forest

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
A large totem pole is stuck in the ground here. It pictures a giant
of a man worshipping - what else?  A tree.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
A small space has been cleared off here, even the stumps of the ironwood
trees have been uprooted and cleared away.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
A large totem pole is stuck in the ground here. It pictures a giant
of a man worshipping - what else?  A tree.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
An exceptionally large ironwood tree grows here. It must be thousands
of years old.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc: To the west grows an exceptionally large ironwood tree.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
A large sinkhole has filled with stagnant water here. It smells like
rotten meat.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
A large pool of muddy water has formed to the west. Elsewhere you see
only more trees.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
The mist that has followed you for so long starts to thin out here, 
but the barrage of trees stays the same.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
The forest seems unending, and the haunting shadows that tail you
begin to grate your nerves.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc: Leaves and branches fall down on you from above, cast by an unseen force.

rooms.name: The Forest
rooms.desc:
The forest is beginning to thin here, but you still can't see far between
the trees.

rooms.desc: The edge of the forest is just ahead, thankfully leading into open land.
